title: Window shell and dock
summary: Optional grouped dock and window lifecycle.

blocks.text: Require ui.shell@^1.0.0 and use WINDOW_SHELL to create a shell for your viewport. Supply grouped panel definitions, borrowed content nodes, input-release/focus callbacks and optional viewer-only chrome preferences. No game-specific panels are created implicitly. The shell owns its windows, dock entries, subscriptions, keyboard/file listeners and styles. Removing it restores borrowed nodes to their original locations.

Use addInstrument for optional windows. Dispose its returned lease when that instrument is removed; the shell does not own borrowed instrument windows. The game can omit the shell entirely. Modal Escape, fullscreen transitions and import-to-panel routing are host callbacks, independent of gameplay/session authority.
Configuration: escapeToggleMs sets the minimum wall-time interval between Escape/fullscreen toggles (default 300 ms). Existing panel layout and preferences keep their defaults.

Game composition can also use the exported createActionDock helper for grouped game-specific actions. It shares native vector button chrome with workspace windows, can borrow existing controls without replacing their listeners, and restores those controls when its lease is disposed. A dock does not create gameplay or session services.
